unverified_issue_candidates.quote:
If the $ \Delta G_{H^{*}}^{a} \leq0 $, the following expressing for the exchange current at pH=0 are used:

$$
i _ {0} = - e \mathrm {k} _ {0} \frac {1} {1 + \exp \left(- \Delta \mathrm {G} _ {H *} ^ {a} / k _ {b} T\right)}
$$

For other case $ \left( \Delta\mathrm{G}_{H^{*}}^{a} > 0\right) $, the exchange current is calculated by:

$$
i _ {0} = - e \mathrm {k} _ {0} \frac {1} {1 + \exp \left(- \Delta \mathrm {G} _ {H *} ^ {a} / k _ {b} T\right)}
$$
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: 两个分支的交换电流公式完全相同，但原文应针对 ΔG_H*^a ≤ 0 和 > 0 给出不同表达式，OCR 丢失了符号差异。
式(15)左侧应为 ΔG_{O*} 而非 ΔG_{OH*}，与式(14)重复，OCR 丢失了 O* 下标。
